purpose: Break the retrospective tuning loop with frozen, timely forecasts on fresh demo candles.
historical_result: Neither design is qualified; historical failures remain blocking.

followthrough_diagnostic.scope: First quote-side barrier over 12 M5 bars, without break-even/trailing/time exits.
limitations: Barrier counts are not executable returns or qualification. Costs and session cutoff are not reproduced by this diagnostic.
M5 bars cannot establish intrabar order; ambiguous bars are stop-first.

observer.purpose: Diagnostic comparison of frozen failed/unqualified hypotheses; not a qualification-stage promotion.
observer.rules: Forecasts must be saved within 120 seconds after close and after registration. Never backfill missed forecasts.
observer.supervision: Existing acceptance supervisor resumes the observer within the deadline, only when the backend and operator state allow it; three starts/hour maximum.
observer.integrity: Changed source, revised closed bars or altered saved evidence halt collection for review; no automatic reset or retraining.
observer.evaluation: This collector saves predictions and later closed candles. Independent cost-aware outcome review is still required. Forecast counts are not trades or qualification cases.

remaining: Prospective outcomes need time and separate review.
Historical failure is not erased by collecting new forecasts.
Measured execution costs, model-specific live parity and guarded broker lifecycle remain prerequisites to any promotion.

future_outcome_review_contract.rule: First modeled M5 opening strictly after the recorded observation timestamp; otherwise wait. Never use a past opening quote.
future_outcome_review_contract.timeliness: Available time after registered start; observation within 0..120 seconds of close.
future_outcome_review_contract.costs: Same frozen base/stress quote-side costs for both models; measured broker costs are still unverified.
future_outcome_review_contract.scope: Future diagnostic outcome review only. This is different from an instantaneous next-open backtest fill and cannot be called exact live parity.
